evidence: 8 runs with clean post-onset median |diff| < 2.0 sigma on every channel; top-channel medians 0.37-1.24 (per-sample noise sigma); names: CS_CENTER_ASSESTMENT_TRANSIENT_LEAKG4;CS_CENTER_CONSTANT_SEGMENT_LEAKG4_WEAK;CS_CENTER_CONSTANT_SEGMENT_LEAKG5_WEAK;CS_DOWNSTREAM_ASSESTMENT_TRANSIENT_LEAKG4;CS_DOWNSTREAM_CONSTANT_SEGMENT_LEAKG4_WEAK;CS_DOWNSTREAM_CONSTANT_SEGMENT_LEAKG5_WEAK;CS_UPSTREAM_CONSTANT_SEGMENT_LEAKG4_WEAK;CS_UPSTREAM_CONSTANT_SEGMENT_LEAKG5_WEAK; independence groups: 3 (IG_ASSESTMENT_TRANSIENT_LEAKG4;IG_CONSTANT_SEGMENT_LEAKG4_STRONG;IG_CONSTANT_SEGMENT_LEAKG5_STRONG)

statement: Cross-topology pressure offsets ~0.13-0.60 MPa, 10-40x the weak-leak signatures
evidence: clean steady NORMAL offsets PS4 0.130-0.604 MPa, PS9 0.163-0.485 MPa. Constant-segment low-visibility runs (n=6): onset signature 0.026-0.075 MPa, offset/signature 1.8-23.2x. Transient runs (n=2): brief onset drop 1.55-1.60 MPa that decays; steady post-onset difference to own NORMAL 0.00022-0.00051 MPa (offset/difference 253-738x)
verdict: REVISED: offsets VERIFIED; ratio is 1.8-23.2x for constant-segment weak leaks, not 10-40x; transient G4 runs drop briefly and then settle much closer to their own NORMAL than the cross-model offset

statement: Weak-leak trajectories converge toward the model-specific NORMAL operating point after onset
evidence: clean |diff to own NORMAL| on top channels: pre-onset median 0.0433, post-onset median 0.00048 (same units); post < pre in 16/16 run-channels
noisy_check: noisy realization, same channels: post |diff| median 0.0004 vs pre 0.0208

statement: G5/G6 and G5_STRONG show visible event signatures despite LEAK->NORMAL misclassification
evidence: CS_CENTER_CONSTANT_SEGMENT_LEAKG5_STRONG: visibility at the windows predicted NORMAL 554.5 sigma (run-level event median 555.0); CS_DOWNSTREAM_ASSESTMENT_TRANSIENT_LEAKG4: visibility at the windows predicted NORMAL 9.1 sigma (run-level event median 0.5); CS_CENTER_ASSESTMENT_TRANSIENT_LEAKG5G6_OVERLAPPED: visibility at the windows predicted NORMAL 1006.0 sigma (run-level event median 1004.4)
